pages.title: Onu Live
pages.creator: Freak X Games
pages.description: Onu Live lets players race to empty their hands in a card-matching game. Play a card that agrees with the discard pile's color, number or symbol, choosing quickly enough to complete the turn within fifteen seconds.

pages.title: Brick Blaze
pages.creator: arcadiumgg
pages.description: Brick Blaze challenges you to clear a wall of bricks with a bouncing ball. Move the paddle left and right to return the ball without letting it fall, collecting power-ups that improve the paddle as you work toward the next level.

pages.title: Fruit Block Tetra Puzzle
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Fruit Block Tetra Puzzle asks you to place fruit-shaped blocks onto a grid. Complete lines to collect the fruits required by each stage, arranging the remaining space carefully. Meet the fruit targets before the timer expires to advance.

pages.title: Lion Family Sim Online
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Lion Family Sim Online follows a lion building a life on the savannah. Hunt for food, explore the surrounding landscape and protect your territory, developing a family as you guide the pride through the simulation's survival challenges.

pages.title: Circuit Master
pages.creator: BeedoGames
pages.description: Circuit Master asks you to connect an electrical circuit so its green light turns on. Drag wires, fans and machines into position, then press the power button to test the arrangement. Use a hint when a missing connection proves difficult to identify.

pages.title: Water Shooter
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Water Shooter arms a young adventurer with a water pistol against fiery monsters. Explore the dungeon from a first-person viewpoint, aim and spray water at the enemies, using movement and jumps to navigate the encounters along the route.

pages.title: Click Kitty Idle
pages.creator: GMgames
pages.description: Click Kitty Idle gives you a short round to earn coins by clicking. Spend them on food for the cat before the timer expires, accounting for the rising purchase price. Keep feeding and leveling the kitty as you pursue a stronger result.

pages.title: Your dream room
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Your dream room gives you an empty room to furnish and decorate. Choose wallpaper, flooring, furniture and accessories, comparing styles and colors as you arrange the space. Combine the selections into a finished interior that reflects your preferred design.

pages.title: Merge Magnat - IDeaL Store
pages.creator: Rainbow Games
pages.description: Merge Magnat - IDeaL Store lets you build a shopping district from individual stores. Place shops to attract customers and combine matching ones into more profitable versions. Reinvest the money they spend in new businesses and improvements across the area.

pages.title: Domino Adventure
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Domino Adventure offers Block and Draw domino modes with several match durations. Place tiles beside matching numbers and plan moves that improve your position against the other players. Collectible domino designs let you change the appearance of the set.

pages.title: Hide Moodeng Hippo!
pages.creator: Momo Games
pages.description: Hide Moodeng Hippo! turns protecting a baby hippo into a physics puzzle. Tap objects to activate their fall and build a shelter over Moodeng before flea balls rain down. Consider how each piece will land before releasing it into the arrangement.

pages.title: Mahjong Adventure: World Quest
pages.creator: Monstera Games
pages.description: Mahjong Adventure: World Quest asks you to remove identical tile pairs while traveling through themed puzzle stages. Match the available tiles and clear the arrangement before the timer runs out, unlocking further locations as you complete each board.

pages.title: Hexa Tile Trio
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Hexa Tile Trio challenges you to clear stacked hexagonal tiles by grouping them in threes. Send a selected tile into an empty or matching space below, keeping enough room for later choices. The level fails if the time or available space runs out.

pages.title: Bomb Head Hot Potato
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description: Bomb Head Hot Potato puts a timed explosive into an arena survival contest. Throw bombs toward opponents and move clear of their explosions, choosing when to attack without remaining in danger yourself. Stay alive while eliminating the other competitors.

pages.title: Bubble Blitz Galaxy
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Bubble Blitz Galaxy asks you to shoot bubbles toward matching colors without letting the field cross its boundary. Try Arcade Mode for a longer survival score, or take on Challenge Mode's target totals while keeping the advancing bubbles under control.

pages.title: Taxi Simulator 2024
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Taxi Simulator 2024 lets you work as a taxi driver in an open environment. Find passengers and follow the directions to their destinations, exploring the streets and addresses across the maps as you complete the assigned transport objectives.

pages.title: Super Soccer Noggins
pages.creator: RavalMatic
pages.description: Super Soccer Noggins lets you choose a nation and compete across unusual football fields. Use the available power-ups during matches and work through competitions for six trophies, adjusting to the changing conditions as you guide the team toward victory.

pages.title: Shoot Block Rush 3D
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Shoot Block Rush 3D sends a firing character through a course full of blocks. Keep shooting to clear the obstacles and slide onto a useful route, choosing abilities that help the character continue through the level's remaining barriers.

pages.title: Master of Numbers
pages.creator: Eccentric Games Studio
pages.description: Master of Numbers turns a number into the character on an obstacle course. Absorb smaller blue values to grow and avoid larger red numbers that end the attempt. Choose a route that preserves enough strength to break walls and reach the finish.

pages.title: Captain Gold
pages.creator: Freak X Games
pages.description: Captain Gold asks you to help a miner break valuable stones with thrown hammers. Time each release to hit the gold, diamonds or other resources in reach, collecting what the captain extracts as you work through the mining challenge.

pages.title: Bestie Hidden and Decorated Egg
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Bestie Hidden and Decorated Egg combines an egg-decorating puzzle with styling two friends. Help Mia and Emma complete the decoration activities, then choose outfits and accessories for them. Finish by presenting the decorated egg alongside their new looks.

pages.title: Color Road
pages.creator: VOODOO
pages.description: Color Road sends a colored ball along a road shared with other balls. Meet those that match your current color and avoid different ones, adapting as targets move and your ball changes color. Keep the run going to extend the distance traveled.

pages.title: Bubble Shooter HD 2
pages.creator: SOFTGAMES – Mobile Entertainment Services GmbH
pages.description: Bubble Shooter HD 2 asks you to clear the board by firing at matching bubble groups. Aim each shot to connect its color and remove a useful section of the field. Choose Novice, Expert or Master mode and compare the results through the statistics feature.

pages.title: Slime Ball
pages.creator: hexapp
pages.description: Slime Ball turns a slime into a football player on a two-dimensional pitch. Move, jump and shoot the ball toward the other side's goal. Play alone or share a two-player match, choosing among the available map settings.

pages.title: Bone Breaker Tycoon
pages.creator: Drmop Games
pages.description: Bone Breaker Tycoon turns a crowd's ragdoll falls into a cartoon business game. Push the characters off mountains and collect the game's payout for their tumbles. Spend the earnings on a larger crowd, improved payouts and additional mountain challenges.

pages.title: Impulse Ball 2
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Impulse Ball 2 challenges you to push colored balls into holes using impulses. Choose where to apply force as you navigate the maze, keeping the balls clear of thorns. White balls crowd the route and make the intended path harder to reach.

pages.title: Ludo Fever
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Ludo Fever lets you race four tokens around the board and into the home area. Roll the die and select a piece to move while trying to send rival tokens back to their start. Play alone or share a game on one device.

pages.title: Funny Puppy Care
pages.creator: iclickgames
pages.description: Funny Puppy Care begins with rescuing a puppy from tar. Wash the dirt away, complete virtual care for its wounds and broken leg, then try mini-games together. Choose clothes and accessories to finish the puppy's recovery and makeover activities.

pages.title: Dr Green Alien 2
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description: Dr Green Alien 2 sends a green alien through a space adventure collecting toxic-waste barrels. Gather the required barrels and points while navigating the route, checking that none have been left behind before heading for the finish line.

pages.title: Train
pages.creator: 2Play
pages.description: Train asks you to pick up everyone waiting in a level. Guide the train through the route with swipes or directional keys, accounting for its growing length after each passenger boards. Collect the entire group to complete the stage.

pages.title: Searching for the Elephant
pages.creator: Garbuz Studio
pages.description: Searching for the Elephant follows a search for a missing animal friend in a black-and-white world. Interact with objects and solve each scene's puzzle to rescue animals from robot researchers, gathering clues that lead toward the lost elephant.

pages.title: Run Zombie Run
pages.creator: danygames.com
pages.description: Run Zombie Run sends you into an infected city to plant eight explosives and escape. Shoot the undead blocking your route, gather useful items and keep moving through the area as you complete the demolition mission.

pages.title: Coaster Racer 2
pages.creator: TurboNuke
pages.description: Coaster Racer 2 lets you compete on elevated tracks in cars or motorcycles. Finish in a qualifying position to unlock the next course, using nitro to gain speed during the race. Additional challenge races give you further driving tasks to attempt.

pages.title: Lipuzz Water Sort Puzzle
pages.creator: UznGames
pages.description: Lipuzz Water Sort Puzzle asks you to separate mixed liquids by pouring between containers. Move matching colors into the same vessel and consider which spaces each transfer will free. Work through the arrangement until the colors have been organized.

pages.title: Climbing Over It
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Climbing Over It puts a hammer at the center of a climbing challenge. Swing it with the mouse or touch controls to pull the character over mountains and rocks. Collect diamonds along the route to move the game forward.

pages.title: Finn's Fantastic Food Machine
pages.creator: Light Wolf Studios
pages.description: Finn's Fantastic Food Machine asks you to catch plates falling from a food machine and serve them to customers. Move beneath the drops and deliver the dishes in the correct order, earning bonuses for accurate, prompt service.

pages.title: Spiderblock
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description: Spiderblock gives a living block a web-like hookshot for crossing platform stages. Move and jump through the layout, then use the hook to travel between walls or past obstacles. Work through ten levels of increasingly demanding routes.

pages.title: Among Impostor Mahjong Connect
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Among Impostor Mahjong Connect challenges you to remove pairs of identical impostor tiles. A connection can bend no more than twice at right angles, so look for open routes between pieces. Clear the board to continue through the levels.

pages.title: Geometry Neon Dash Rainbow
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Geometry Neon Dash Rainbow sends a small square through a colorful course of deadly obstacles. Time its movement to keep it clear of the hazards and continue along the endless route, trying to carry the attempt farther before making a mistake.

pages.title: Super Archer
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Super Archer follows an archer crossing a monster-filled valley in a side-scrolling adventure. Move across platforms and use the attack control against threats, looking for every star in the stage as you work toward completing its route.

pages.title: Super SUV Driving
pages.creator: G55.CO
pages.description: Super SUV Driving lets you choose an SUV and explore a large city. Drive across its roads, brake around turns and switch camera views to inspect the vehicle from different angles as you discover more of the urban environment.

pages.title: Find Seven Differences Animals
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Find Seven Differences Animals gives you ten pairs of animal pictures to compare. Locate seven changes without relying on hints, selecting each one to mark it with a red circle. Finish before time expires and avoid careless clicks on matching details.

pages.title: Fit Balls
pages.creator: BPTop
pages.description: Fit Balls challenges you to fit a collection of balls inside a jar. Pour them into the container and account for the space they occupy, keeping every ball below the top boundary. An overflow means trying the arrangement again.

pages.title: Autumn Slide
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Autumn Slide offers three autumn pictures in sliding layouts of three, four or five tiles per side. Shift the pieces through the available gap and plan their order, reconstructing the image without leaving its sections out of place.

pages.title: Brainy Cars
pages.creator: Royale Gamers
pages.description: Brainy Cars asks you to draw the routes that drivers will follow toward their destinations. Hold and drag to create straight or curved paths, reacting quickly enough to guide the moving cars through the route as the scene develops.

pages.title: Hidden Investigation: Who Did it?
pages.creator: Brave Giant LTD
pages.description: Hidden Investigation: Who Did it? follows detective Sarah investigating Lacy Monroe's disappearance. Search scenes for hidden objects, solve puzzles and talk to characters, using their clues to work toward uncovering what happened to the missing woman.

pages.title: BFF Summer Fashion
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: BFF Summer Fashion lets you create warm-weather looks for Mia and Bella. Choose makeup that suits each friend, then coordinate the available clothes into summer outfits. Compare different combinations as you complete the pair's new seasonal style.

pages.title: Sort Hoop
pages.creator: BPTop
pages.description: Sort Hoop challenges you to organize colored hoops into matching stacks. Select a hoop and move it onto another of the same color, considering how the remaining colors can be transferred before committing to the next placement.

pages.title: Ball Clash
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Ball Clash turns pocketing balls into a sequence of aiming puzzles. Drag to set the direction and release a shot, planning how to strike the remaining balls. Clear every ball into the holes to complete the level.

pages.title: Ultimate Flying Car 3d
pages.creator: Driving games
pages.description: Ultimate Flying Car 3d lets you drive on roads and switch to flying through the environment. Complete the missions to unlock faster cars, using boost and air brakes to manage the vehicle as its controls change between driving and flight.

pages.title: Parking Jam 3D
pages.creator: JZJO.COM
pages.description: Parking Jam 3D asks you to empty a crowded car park. Hold a car and push it forward or backward along its route, choosing a sequence that frees the blocked vehicles. Release every car from the lot to finish the stage.

pages.title: Blackjack King Offline
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Blackjack King Offline offers a simulated blackjack table without real-money stakes. Play the card rounds and compare your hand with the dealer's, deciding how to continue each turn as you work through the traditional casino-card activity.

pages.title: Tap Tap Monsters
pages.creator: NoticeGames.com
pages.description: Tap Tap Monsters turns clicking and combining creatures into an evolution game. Develop the available monsters into more advanced forms and move through their different worlds, continuing the merging process to discover the next creature in the sequence.

pages.title: New French Braid Hairstyle
pages.creator: igirlgames
pages.description: New French Braid Hairstyle takes you through creating a braided hairstyle for a character. Follow the styling activity and work with the available hair sections, developing the French-braid look step by step until the hairstyle is finished.

pages.title: Baking Apple Cake
pages.creator: Baby Hazel
pages.description: Baking Apple Cake puts you alongside a mother preparing an apple dessert. Gather the ingredients and follow the game's baking instructions, working through the recipe before adding chocolate-chip ice cream to the servings.

pages.title: Finger Painting
pages.creator: TrendyGames
pages.description: Finger Painting gives you pictures to decorate with freehand marks and colors. Move the mouse to paint or scribble, adding your own lines and shades wherever you choose. Experiment with the image to create a finished drawing in your preferred style.

pages.title: 2D Car Parking
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: 2D Car Parking puts a car into a series of overhead parking challenges. Use the directional controls to maneuver through each layout, carefully lining up the vehicle as you work toward completing the parking position for the level.

pages.title: Bubble Shooter Fruits
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Bubble Shooter Fruits fills its boards with fruit-shaped targets. Shoot matching fruit into groups of at least three to remove them, finding useful angles through the remaining arrangement. Clear the required field to complete each level's challenge.

pages.title: Jelly Collapse Challenge
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Jelly Collapse Challenge lets you remove connected jelly groups from a board. Choose matching items joined horizontally or vertically, clearing larger clusters for more points. Collect more than seven at once to receive a bomb, arrow or magnet power-up.

pages.title: Axe Throw Hit And Champ
pages.creator: Good Funny Game
pages.description: Axe Throw Hit And Champ gives you targets to break with thrown axes. Line up a throw and release it toward a useful mark, trying to keep the hits coming as you work toward a higher score.

pages.title: BTS Fruits Coloring Book
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: BTS Fruits Coloring Book offers fruit pictures to decorate with crayons, brushes and tint choices. Select a drawing and apply the shades you prefer, experimenting with different tools to create your own version of the fruit scene.

pages.title: Master Sushi
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Master Sushi combines a paddle-and-ball game with an advancing field of bricks. Move the paddle to return the ball into the blocks and keep them from reaching the bottom. React to the increasing pace as the endless round continues.

pages.title: Monster High Twyla Dreamland Dressup
pages.creator: Girls Games
pages.description: Monster High Twyla Dreamland Dressup lets you create a new look for Twyla. Browse the clothing and makeover choices, combining the available pieces into an outfit for the shy Monster High character as you work through her styling activity.

pages.title: Volkswagen T Roc R Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Volkswagen T Roc R Puzzle offers six vehicle pictures with four jigsaw sizes for each. Choose 16, 36, 64 or 100 pieces and rebuild the selected car image, matching the shapes and details until the scene is complete.

pages.title: Car Eats Car Evil Cars
pages.creator: SMOKOKO LTD
pages.description: Car Eats Car Evil Cars puts you on the side of the cars pursued by police and other traffic. Balance the vehicle across the route, activate turbo and drop bombs against threats, helping the group survive its rescue adventure.

pages.title: Aquarium Game
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Aquarium Game combines fish-tank cleaning with aquarium decoration. Move the fish out of the tank, replace the water and complete the cleaning activities, then arrange fish and decorative items inside. Shape the refreshed aquarium into the design you prefer.

pages.title: EG Handless Millionaire
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: EG Handless Millionaire turns collecting cash into a cartoon timing challenge. Reach through a moving guillotine to grab the banknotes and pull back before the blade falls. Judge its rhythm carefully as you try to carry the game-show attempt farther.

pages.title: Color by Number 3D
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Color by Number 3D gives you three-dimensional objects divided into numbered areas. Select a model and apply the corresponding colors to its sections, following the numbers as the completed image gradually appears across the object's surface.

pages.title: Stack Panda
pages.creator: Mobi2Fun
pages.description: Stack Panda asks you to jump over blocks arriving from both sides. Land above each new section so it becomes part of the growing tower beneath the panda. Keep timing the jumps to make the endless stack higher.

pages.title: EG Mysterious Candies
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: EG Mysterious Candies sends pink and green sweets toward a bowl. Change the color with a click or tap so each candy lands in a matching bowl, reacting as the pace increases and trying to keep the sequence correct.

pages.title: Pet Salon Kitty Care
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Pet Salon Kitty Care puts you in a cat-grooming salon with scheduled clients. Check appointments at reception, then bathe the visiting cat, dry it and brush the fur. Work through each pet's care activities as the salon's day continues.

pages.title: Homemade Pizza Cooking
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Homemade Pizza Cooking helps Mia prepare dinner at home. Work through the pizza-making activity, cutting vegetables and arranging them as toppings. Follow the available preparation steps to finish the homemade meal for her weekend evening.

pages.title: Takeoff
pages.creator: Gamebuilt.com
pages.description: Takeoff asks you to construct a spaceship by merging its pieces. Find suitable parts to combine and keep developing the assembly, considering which remaining pieces can join together as you work toward the completed spacecraft.

pages.title: Super Jump Box
pages.creator: T
pages.description: Super Jump Box asks you to carry a white block along a trail of colored platforms. Tap the color corresponding to the next landing to make the jump, watching the sequence as you try to keep the block advancing and improve your score.

pages.title: Zombie Defense
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Zombie Defense puts you against approaching groups of zombies with a gun and a limited health supply. Keep firing at the enemies and use the shop to improve the defense, preparing for the stronger encounters as the fight continues.

pages.title: Fidgetio.com
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: Fidgetio.com puts a spinning character into an arena of collectibles and rivals. Gather items to grow, use the boost to change your movement and try to defeat other spinners. Keep developing the character while pursuing higher score and elimination totals.

pages.title: Monster Slumber Party Funny Faces
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Monster Slumber Party Funny Faces lets you style Monster High characters for a playful pajama party. Choose humorous face-paint designs and coordinate tops, bottoms, dresses or shoes, combining the options into a party look for each participant.

pages.title: TEN
pages.creator: RedFoc
pages.description: TEN turns number merging into a sliding puzzle on a four-by-four grid. Swipe to move the tiles and combine matching values, considering how each move changes the available spaces. Keep building larger numbers while working toward a higher score.

pages.title: Sky Fight
pages.creator: Lucky Red Fish
pages.description: Sky Fight puts you in a fighter plane battling other pilots. Use machine guns to shoot down opponents and catch parachutes for temporary improvements, including better movement, speed or shields. Keep maneuvering through the air while looking for the next target.

pages.title: BLACKJACK 21
pages.creator: RedFoc
pages.description: BLACKJACK 21 brings you to a card table against a dealer. Compare your hand with the dealer's and choose how to play each round, working through the game's blackjack decisions as you try to win the matchups.

pages.title: Bottle Flip Challenge DAB 2
pages.creator: Pupgam Studios
pages.description: Bottle Flip Challenge DAB 2 challenges you to land a sequence of bottle flips. Complete three successful flips in a row to unlock another bottle, keeping the streak intact because a failed landing sends you back to the start of the sequence.

pages.title: Temple Puzzle
pages.creator: Kizi
pages.description: Temple Puzzle presents temple-themed pictures broken into separate puzzle sections. Move the pieces into the correct positions to restore each image, using the visible shapes and details to work out how the remaining fragments join together.

pages.title: Submarines EG
pages.creator: ESERGAMES
pages.description: Submarines EG asks you to eliminate enemy submarines while dodging missiles. Keep your attacks directed toward the underwater targets and watch the incoming threats, balancing offense with evasive movement so the encounter can continue.

pages.title: Monster Truck Jigsaw
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Monster Truck Jigsaw turns a monster-truck picture into scattered puzzle pieces. Drag each section into its proper place and use the vehicle's details to guide the arrangement, continuing until the full truck image is restored.

pages.title: Foot Brain
pages.creator: Ixel Games
pages.description: Foot Brain sends a runner toward touchdowns through a field of zombies. Steer around the undead and collect energy drinks that let you defeat them, continuing across the field to earn medals for successful scoring runs.

pages.title: Princess Best Friends Day
pages.creator: Games Banner Network
pages.description: Princess Best Friends Day lets Snow White and Anna revisit the beginning of their friendship through a memory activity. After recreating their first meeting, help them exchange wardrobes for a day and try each other's signature clothing styles.

pages.title: Mermaid Doll Wedding
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Mermaid Doll Wedding lets you style an underwater bride and her bridesmaids. Try dresses, veils and hairstyles for the mermaid doll, then coordinate outfits for her friends. Compare the combinations to finish the wedding party's appearance.

pages.title: Dragon Ball Super Bulma Dress Up
pages.creator: Kawaii Games
pages.description: Dragon Ball Super Bulma Dress Up gives you clothing and hairstyle choices for Bulma. Try different tops, dresses and other wardrobe pieces, coordinating their details to create a new look for the Dragon Ball character.

pages.title: Sofia Once Upon A Princess!
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Sofia Once Upon A Princess! lets you dress Sofia for a ball at her palace. Choose clothing and coordinate the available fashion pieces into a complete royal look, preparing the princess for her role at the celebration.

pages.title: Sisters Dressing Room
pages.creator: DariaGames.com
pages.description: Sisters Dressing Room opens the wardrobes of two sisters for a styling session. Select dresses and coordinate bags and other accessories, putting together a different finished outfit for each woman from the clothes available in the room.

pages.title: Pregnant Princesses Fashion Dressing Roo
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Pregnant Princesses Fashion Dressing Roo lets you choose new looks for two expectant princesses. Browse the wardrobe and coordinate clothing for each character, trying different combinations until both have finished outfits for their fashion makeover.

pages.title: Monster Hands
pages.creator: bestphysics
pages.description: Monster Hands asks you to rotate monsters until their hands connect. Turn each character to line up the network and aim to place the joins over stars, working out a complete connected arrangement for the level.

pages.title: Fashion Magazine
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Fashion Magazine puts you in charge of models preparing for a major fashion appearance. Choose outfits from the available clothing selections and coordinate each character's look, styling the group after their magazine-cover feature.
